FUTURESPORTFUTURE 2026

Date
3 October 2026
Place
Belgrade (Serbia)

On 3 October 2026, in Belgrade, FutureSportFuture took place. This is what it left behind.

SPORT

the tree of sport

In our life, which can be imagined as a perfect ecosystem, Sport has a very prominent place. We can see it as one magnificent tree on a very visible hill. The deep and invisible root of that wonderful tree as well as its trunk is human culture, that part of it related to man’s need for physical movement and organized competition. Countless branches and even more leaves are actually numerous sports and even more numerous athletes of all ages. That beautiful and ever-growing tree has its bright future only if man takes care of its roots and its general health. Otherwise, all the leaves and branches will dry up, fall off and end up in who knows what kind of emptiness of scaly carelessness and his blinding by momentary interest or greed. And our life, that is, the ecosystem to which we belong, needs that healthy tree, free from any form of our misunderstanding or disrespect for culture as the basic source of social survival.

CULTURE

SPORT is the crown.
CULTURE is the root and the trunk.

support for the values

SUPPORT FOR THE VALUES

I, from , without any institutional formality, with no obligation to pay anything and without committing myself to any action, knowingly and with enthusiasm support the values NewSportVision stands up for and promotes. I give this support in a symbolic, declarative and voluntary way, wishing the values NewSportVision stands for to gain the widest possible momentum and strength. If this declaration of mine helps bring that about, it will be a fine thing, and it will leave me with the satisfaction of having contributed to improving the world we live in.
